powerful radio jets from accreting supermassive black hole quasars are triggered by the collapse of a protocluster, and then provide feedback that shuts down the growth of all galaxies in the protocluster.
powerful-jet feedback shuts down the star formation and black-hole growth of galaxies in protoclusters, and that powerful-jet outbursts probably occur in all protoclusters in the Universe.

powerful-jet feedback is the dominant mode of quasar feedback, and that powerful-jet outflow episodes probably occurred in every cluster in the Universe, with the consequence that all the galaxies seen today in clusters were probably shut down during a single powerful jet-triggered episode in the past.
